I'm tired of going to therapy and waiting on him to recognize whats right and wrong. Obviously the most selfish reason is because I don't know how I'll get the money to pay for my second year. ​ I asked some close girlfriends about this and they all think I should wait until I graduate before asking for divorce. They said he's been a total ass to me so this is a small bit of retribution, and that I deserve to get my degree at the very least. WIBTA if I actually did this?
